name: CRAFTER-XAI-Bench
description: A benchmark framework built on an open-world reinforcement learning environment to rigorously assess explanation faithfulness of Agentic XAI systems integrating LLMs. It features complex models with diverse goals and challenging test scenarios.
reputation: A specialized research benchmark with limited but growing interest in evaluating explanation faithfulness for agentic XAI systems.
notes: Focuses on improving and evaluating explanation faithfulness in Agentic XAI using a systematic verification process.
